BILLS_CARD_APPEND_MISMATCH: Blocks appended to the Bills card did not read back as written.
Check the page; retried next run.
BILLS_CARD_NOT_OWNED: The Bills card block is not one V7 owns, so nothing is changed.
None; the card never edits what it does not own.
BILLS_CARD_SNAPSHOT_INVALID: The stored Bills snapshot is not valid for the card.
BILLS_CARD_SNAPSHOT_MISSING: No Bills snapshot is stored yet for the card.
None; the snapshot stage runs first.
BILLS_CARD_STORE_FAILED: The card's record could not be stored.
BILLS_CARD_VERIFY_FAILED: The Bills card did not read back as written.
BILLS_DATE_INVALID: A date in the Bills data is not valid.
BILLS_DUPLICATE_PAGE_ID: Two Bills rows share one page id, so paid processing stops.
BILLS_FORMULA_INVALID: A Bills formula result is not the expected shape.
BILLS_LEDGER_INVALID: The paid-bills ledger holds an invalid entry.
BILLS_NOTION_PAGE_INCOMPLETE: A Notion page read for the Bills card was incomplete.
BILLS_NOTION_PAGINATION_INCOMPLETE: A Notion list for the Bills card did not finish paging.
BILLS_NOTION_PAGINATION_INVALID: Notion paging for the Bills card repeated a cursor.
BILLS_PAGE_ID_MISMATCH: A Bills page id changed between read and write.
BILLS_PAGE_INCOMPLETE: A Bills page read was incomplete.
BILLS_PAGE_INVALID: One Bills row is not valid; it is skipped and counted.
BILLS_PAGINATION_INVALID: Notion paging repeated a cursor while reading Bills.
BILLS_PAID_FAILED: Paid-bill processing failed for an unnamed reason.
Retried next run; check the log.
BILLS_PROPERTY_INVALID: A Bills row property has the wrong type; the row is skipped and counted.
BILLS_PROPERTY_MISSING: A required Bills property is missing from the database.
BILLS_PROTECTED_REGION_CHANGED: Jim's protected content changed during a write, so the write stops.
None; nothing of Jim's is overwritten.
BILLS_PROTECTED_REGION_UNAVAILABLE: A protected block could not be read, so no write is made.
BILLS_READ_FAILED: Bills could not be read from Notion.
BILLS_SNAPSHOT_INVALID: The stored Bills snapshot is not valid.
BILLS_SNAPSHOT_MISSING: No Bills snapshot is stored yet.
None; the snapshot stage runs first.
BILLS_SOURCE_INVALID: The Bills source database is not the expected one.
BILLS_SOURCE_MISMATCH: The Bills source differs from the one the ledger names.
BILLS_STORE_FAILED: The Bills snapshot could not be stored.
